verdict.rationale: Kick documents an editable Chart of Accounts: you can start from a standard CoA and add, rename, or restructure accounts. 'Classes' appear only as a line item in the Plus plan table, with no documentation of how they work as a dimension. missing for 10: explicit documentation of account types, sub-account hierarchy, how class/tag dimensions are configured and applied, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: Kick sets up a standard Chart of Accounts when you create your workspace, and you or your accountant can adjust it from there: adding, renaming, or restructuring accounts as needed
Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
